svg.title: TruffleData 0.12.0 · YAML: YAML on Native Image
svg.desc: 1,000 block-style records: Tape + interop reads 204, Typed plan 152, Java Map/List tree 136, Truffle object tree 122, Heap snapshot 71.1. 1,000 flow-style records: Tape + interop reads 167, Typed plan 127, Java Map/List tree 131, Truffle object tree 117, Heap snapshot 70.1. Java heap · block records: Tape + interop reads 477, Typed plan 144, Java Map/List tree 1,337, Truffle object tree 1,736, Heap snapshot 1,884.
svg.text: One parser, five ways to consume it. No other YAML library is in the native image, so this card compares TruffleData APIs
bytes allocated / record · lower is better
Bars: median of six fresh processes (two interleaved groups of three on one host and CPU); whiskers: min–max of all six, not confidence intervals.
Static rapidyaml archive; every engine reads the same ten members per record.
One quiet host (AMD Ryzen Threadripper PRO 9965WX 24-Cores), every shard in sequence on one pinned CPU · Linux x86-64 · GraalVM Native Image · O2 · serial GC · no PGO.
TruffleData 0.12.0 (c378d6d) · measured 2026-11-12 · image sha256 061ab8b33a68 · hashes in manifest.json
